application.description: The deadline by which an application or proposal must be submitted. The default answer to "when must I apply by?" — every per-type proposal/application deadline folds in under this label.

community feedback.description: The deadline for public comment on a proposal, where the process runs a community-feedback window before the application window closes. A listing that carries only one deadline routinely loses this one.

registration.description: The deadline to register or sign up for an event, as distinct from submitting work. Most commonly used on hackathons.

submission.description: The deadline to submit a project or deliverable after registering. On hackathons this is normally later than 'registration' and at or before 'event end'.

event start.description: The moment an event begins. An EVENT BOUNDARY, not a deadline — it shares the array because the standard keeps one date model, which is exactly why consumers must filter on label rather than taking the array head.

event end.description: The moment an event finishes. An event boundary, not a deadline.
